applicability_limitations: No independent experimental validation was performed.
R>=1 is a dry-spot-free saturation closure, not a positive-root local solution.
Closure inputs are partly assumed in the current literature comparison.
Limited MATLAB-to-Python Figure 2 parity does not certify other legacy figures or the physical closures.
residual_risk: Permeability and evaporation closures may dominate geometry ranking.
Bubble-length convention and contact-angle basis can change the normalized master-curve ordinate; only the latter leaves R unchanged in the screened sensitivity.
Terminal CHF agreement cannot identify the local-supply mechanism without intermediate observables.
